name: Shitai o Umeru Hanashi
source:
On that night, he killed his mother.

He buried his mother's corpse with his best friend.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30276]Freem![/url]]
translation:
那天晚上，他杀了他的母亲。

他和他最好的朋友一起埋葬了母亲的尸体。
